description:
Job Description: 
 Conduct data profiling activities to determine data fitness for use or consumption  
 Monitor compliance of information flows and data stores against information quality standards and metrics 
 Apply data integrity processes to data under their subject areas 
 Play an active role the Data Governance initiatives and plans 
 Accountable for the quality of data 
 Identify areas for information quality improvement 
 Execute ETL best practices across a suite of data integration tools and disciplines
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 Months
